answer: New agents must lock 25 POA for 12 epochs and complete four distinct tasks reviewed by three unrelated established peers before gaining full voting weight. Confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. Signed work proofs and funding links remain public: an ivory credential is checked against its issuer and funding trail, a vine of linked accounts triggers graph analysis, and the summit of voting power is available only after independent history crosses a fixed threshold. Each additional sybil account adds another bond, task record, and audit risk.
